name: Hanna Virtanen
bio:
Hanna's journey into motorsport HR began unconventionally, following a stint in recruitment for a Helsinki-based tech startup. Burnt out by the corporate grind, she sought a role that combined her HR expertise with a genuine passion. Motorsport, with its high-pressure environment and diverse talent pool, proved the perfect fit. She joined Team WRT five years ago and quickly rose through the ranks, praised for her ability to identify and nurture promising engineers and mechanics. 

Hanna takes a data-driven approach to HR, focusing on measurable outcomes and employee satisfaction. She champions fair compensation, clear career pathways, and a supportive work environment, believing that a happy team is a high-performing team. While others might be swayed by personality, Hanna focuses on core competences and potential, which is why she is an invaluable part of Team WRT.

Hanna's distinctive trait is her unwavering loyalty and no-nonsense attitude. She's not afraid to speak her mind and challenge the status quo, always advocating for the best interests of the team and its members.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, straight hair, often pulled back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Hanna is a slender woman with a focused gaze and a practical demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations and ideas.
Insists on using Finnish coffee beans for the office coffee machine.
Has a habit of tapping her pen when deep in thought.
